name: MDCrow
description: LLM agent that sets up, runs and analyses molecular dynamics simulations with OpenMM from a text prompt.
whatItDoes: Automates molecular dynamics workflows for computational chemists, including structure retrieval, simulation setup, execution and analysis.
howItWorks: A LangChain agent chooses among tools for file handling, simulation with OpenMM and trajectory analysis. It is used as a Python object inside a conda environment, with provider keys in an env file.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: OpenAI, TogetherAI, Fireworks or another supported provider, set in .env
